title: Locate, Judge, Read: Role-Specialized Tool Agents over a Knowledge-Point Index for Open-Domain Multimodal Document QA
title_zh: 定位、判断与阅读：面向开放域多模态文档问答的知识点索引中的角色专用工具智能体

paragraphs.en: We address question answering over large heterogeneous document collections: thousands of PDFs with tables and figures (open-domain M3DocVQA), chart-dense long reports (MMLongBench-Doc) and multi-document news corpora (MultiHop-RAG). A system must first find the right passages and then read them; current retrieval-augmented agents give one model both kinds of tools and let it schedule itself. We present KnowForge, a pipeline separated by job : knowledge construction into a hybrid-retrieval knowledge-point index; a Locator agent that can only search; a code-scheduled bridge judge that forces the missing second hop; a typed, size-bounded evidence pool that merges every search’s ranking; a Deep Reader agent that can only read text, images and tables; and a synthesizer with a format checker. With a self-hosted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (3B active), KnowForge reaches F1 47.5 on the full M3DocVQA (2,441 questions, 3,368 PDFs): +11.0 over the published M3DocRAG system (ColPali + Qwen2-VL-7B, 36.5) and +7.1 over one-shot retrieve-and-answer on the same index and model; 53.5 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On the multi-document MultiHop-RAG it reaches 73.5 accuracy, above the strongest published RAG and GraphRAG results (71.2 with Llama-3.1-70B) and the original GPT-4 baseline (56.0). On the single-document MMLongBench-Doc the pipeline lifts the same 3B-active model by 12.2 points, from 34.8 in one shot to 47.0, to the level of GPT-4o reading page images (46.3); only frontier vision-language models and RL-trained readers score higher. Per-job ablations on the full benchmarks attribute the gain: the Deep Reader is worth 3.8, 9.8 and 0 points on the three corpora, tracking how visual each is; merging both agents into one with all tools and twice the rounds loses 1.9 F1 because it keeps searching instead of reading; a round-budget sweep shows a step at four Locator rounds and a plateau beyond, and query latency scales with model calls rather than corpus size. To make these numbers checkable, we serve the three indexed benchmarks as read-only knowledge bases (free registration) and release all prompts and the runner code, so that retrieval recall can be reproduced without any model and answer accuracy with one’s own: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench .
paragraphs.zh: 我们解决了在大型异构文档集合中进行问答的问题：这些集合包含数千份带有表格和图表的 PDF（开放域 M3DocVQA）、图表密集型的长报告（MMLongBench-Doc）以及多文档新闻语料库（MultiHop-RAG）。 一个系统必须首先找到正确的段落，然后进行阅读；当前的检索增强型智能体将这两类工具同时提供给单个模型，并允许其自行安排使用顺序。 我们提出了 KnowForge，这是一条按任务分离的流程：知识构建阶段生成一个混合检索的知识点索引；Locator 智能体仅能执行搜索；由代码调度的桥接判断器强制完成缺失的第二步跳转；一个带类型和大小限制的证据池会合并每次搜索的排名结果；Deep Reader 智能体仅能阅读文本、图像和表格；以及一个带有格式检查器的合成器。 使用自托管的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（3B 活跃参数）模型，KnowForge 在完整的 M3DocVQA 数据集上（2,441 个问题，3,368 份 PDF）达到了 47.5 的 F1 分数：比已发表的 M3DocRAG 系统（ColPali + Qwen2-VL-7B，36.5）高出 11.0，比在同一索引和模型上采用单次检索并回答的方法高出 7.1；使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 时则达到 53.5。 在多文档的 MultiHop-RAG 数据集上，其准确率达到 73.5，超过了最强的已发表 RAG 和 GraphRAG 结果（Llama-3.1-70B 为 71.2），也优于原始的 GPT-4 基线模型（56.0）。 在单文档的 MMLongBench-Doc 数据集上，该流程使同一 3B 活跃参数模型的性能提升了 12.2 分，从单次处理的 34.8 提升至 47.0，达到了 GPT-4o 阅读页面图像的水平（46.3）；只有前沿视觉语言模型和强化学习训练的阅读器得分更高。 在完整基准数据集上进行的任务级消融分析揭示了性能提升的来源：Deep Reader 在三个语料库上的贡献分别为 3.8、9.8 和 0 分，反映了各语料库的视觉化程度；将两个智能体合并为一个并赋予所有工具和双倍轮次后，F1 分数下降了 1.9，因为系统会持续搜索而非阅读；对轮次预算的扫描显示，在四轮 Locator 操作后性能出现跃升，之后则趋于平稳，且查询延迟与模型调用次数相关，而非语料库大小。 为确保这些结果可验证，我们将三个已建索引的基准数据集作为只读知识库提供服务（免费注册），并公开了所有提示词和运行代码，因此无需任何模型即可复现检索召回率，也可使用自己的模型评估回答准确性：https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench。

paragraphs.en: Answering a question over thousands of documents requires two different skills that pull in opposite directions. Finding the right passages is an open-ended search problem: there is always another query to try. Extracting the answer from a found passage is a closed reading problem: it requires opening a table, looking at a figure, or reading the paragraph around a hit, and it stops when the answer is in hand. Agentic RAG systems give a single model both kinds of tools and a round budget and let the model schedule itself Li et al. (2025a) ; Li et al. (2025b) ; Li et al. (2026) . We find that when the two skills share one loop, the model systematically prefers the one with the immediate reward: it searches again rather than reading deeper. In our controlled comparison, a single agent with every tool and eight rounds made 34% more searches, read half as often, never opened a reading tool on 74% of questions, and scored 1.9 F1 lower than two agents with disjoint tools and four rounds each (§ 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在数千份文档中回答问题需要两种截然不同的技能，而这两种技能的运作方向却相互对立。 找到合适的段落是一个开放式的搜索问题：总会有另一个查询可以尝试。 从找到的段落中提取答案则是一个封闭的阅读理解问题：它需要打开表格、查看图表，或阅读匹配内容周围的段落，并在获得答案后停止。 Agentic RAG 系统为单个模型同时提供这两种工具以及一定轮数的预算，并允许模型自行安排任务 Li et al. (2025a) ; Li et al. (2025b) ; Li et al. (2026) 。 我们发现，当这两种技能共享同一个循环时，模型会系统性地偏好能立即获得奖励的那一种：它会选择再次搜索，而不是更深入地阅读。 在我们的受控对比实验中，一个配备了所有工具且拥有八轮次机会的单一智能体，其搜索次数比两个分别配备独立工具且各拥有四轮次的智能体多 34%，阅读频率则低一半，在 74% 的问题上从未使用过阅读工具，并且 F1 分数低了 1.9（§ 5.2）。

paragraphs.en: Prior systems take one of three routes. Single-pass retrieve-then-read systems such as M3DocRAG Cho et al. (2024) and HiKEY Shin et al. (2026) retrieve once and answer; they cannot recover the second document of a multi-hop question or open a figure they did not retrieve. Single-agent iterative systems (Search-o1 Li et al. (2025a) , WebThinker Li et al. (2025b) , DeepRead Li et al. (2026) , SimpleDoc Jain et al. (2025) ) let one model holding every tool decide when to search and when to read; we show below that such a model prefers to search. Multi-agent systems split roles by modality (MDocAgent Han et al. (2025b) ) or, most recently, by explore/refine/reflect stages on a single long document (MARDoc Chen et al. (2026) , MAGE-RAG Zuo et al. (2026) ), but keep overlapping tool sets, leave the second hop to the model, and report no full-benchmark measurement of what each role is worth (Table 1 ). Our step is to separate by job with physically disjoint tools, force the second hop in code, hand over through a typed evidence pool, and quantify each part against the published systems on three full public benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的系统采用三种路线之一。单次检索后阅读的系统（如 M3DocRAG Cho et al. (2024) 和 HiKEY Shin et al. (2026)）仅执行一次检索便直接作答；它们无法恢复多跳问题中的第二份文档，也无法打开未检索到的图表。单智能体迭代系统（Search-o1 Li et al. (2025a)、WebThinker Li et al. (2025b)、DeepRead Li et al. (2026)、SimpleDoc Jain et al. (2025)）则让一个同时持有所有工具的智能体自行决定何时检索、何时阅读；下文我们将展示，这类智能体更倾向于优先检索。多智能体系统按模态划分角色（MDocAgent Han et al. (2025b)），或最近按对单篇长文档的“探索/精炼/反思”阶段进行分工（MARDoc Chen et al. (2026)、MAGE-RAG Zuo et al. (2026)），但这些系统仍保留重叠的工具集，将第二跳推理留给模型，且未报告各角色价值在完整基准测试中的具体表现（表 1）。我们的方法则是按任务划分职责，使用物理上分离的工具，通过代码强制执行第二跳推理，经由类型化的证据池传递信息，并在三个完整的公开基准测试中，将各部分性能与已发表的系统进行量化对比。

paragraphs.en: Knowledge construction and hybrid retrieval (offline). Documents become Markdown (OCR where needed), split into text, image, table and example fragments; images and tables get VLM descriptions; atomic knowledge points are extracted and linked by typed relations; everything is indexed for BM25 and dense retrieval with bounded graph expansion.
paragraphs.zh: 知识构建与混合检索（离线）。 文档转换为 Markdown（必要时进行 OCR），拆分为文本、图像、表格和示例片段；图像和表格通过 VLM 生成描述；提取原子知识点并通过类型化关系进行关联；所有内容均被索引，用于 BM25 和基于有界图扩展的密集检索。

sents.en: Knowledge construction and hybrid retrieval (offline).
sents.zh: 知识构建与混合检索（离线）。

sents.en: Documents become Markdown (OCR where needed), split into text, image, table and example fragments; images and tables get VLM descriptions; atomic knowledge points are extracted and linked by typed relations; everything is indexed for BM25 and dense retrieval with bounded graph expansion.

paragraphs.en: Locator. An agent whose only tools search and enumerate (search, list books, table of contents, table lookup). It cannot read.
paragraphs.zh: 定位器。 一个智能体，其唯一工具是搜索和枚举（搜索、列出书籍、目录、表格查找）。它无法阅读。

sents.zh: 定位器。

paragraphs.en: Bridge judge. A code-level step that asks, after locating, whether the evidence covers every hop of the question and, if not, issues one targeted follow-up search for the missing “bridge” document.
paragraphs.zh: 桥接判断。 一个代码层面的步骤：在定位证据后，判断其是否覆盖了问题的每一个环节；如果未覆盖，则针对缺失的“桥接”文档发起一次有针对性的后续搜索。

sents.en: Bridge judge.
sents.zh: 桥接判断。

sents.en: A code-level step that asks, after locating, whether the evidence covers every hop of the question and, if not, issues one targeted follow-up search for the missing “bridge” document.

paragraphs.en: Multi-list ranked merge. All searches are merged into one 30K-token evidence pool that is typed : text, images, tables and examples are ranked in separate sub-pools with their own caps, because text hits score higher than media hits and a single ranked list evicts figures and tables first.
paragraphs.zh: 多列表排名合并。 所有搜索结果都合并为一个包含 30K 个标记的证据池，其中文本、图像、表格和示例被分置于各自的子池中，并设有独立的容量限制，因为文本匹配的得分高于媒体内容匹配，而单一排名列表会优先排除图表和表格。

paragraphs.en: A design principle and its realisation. The unit of design for a document-QA agent is the job, not the round: Locator and Deep Reader are separate agents with physically disjoint tool sets, the second hop is forced by a code-level bridge judge rather than left to the model, and the hand-off between them is a typed, size-bounded evidence pool that merges every search’s ranking so that figures and tables are not ranked out by text (§ 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 设计原则及其实现。 文档问答智能体的设计单元是任务，而非轮次：Locator 和 Deep Reader 是两个独立的智能体，其工具集在物理上相互分离；第二次跳转由代码层面的桥接判断强制执行，而非交由模型自行决定；两者之间的交接是一个带有类型定义且大小受限的证据池，该证据池会合并每次搜索的排名结果，从而确保图表不会被文本内容挤出排名（第 3 节）。

paragraphs.zh: 各项任务的增益归因（均基于完整基准测试）：Deep Reader 在 M3DocVQA 上贡献了 3.8 的 F1 分数，在 MMLongBench-Doc 上贡献了 9.8 分，而在纯文本的 MultiHop-RAG 上则为 0，这反映了语料库的视觉化程度；角色分离本身在与仅使用单一智能体（配备所有工具且轮次翻倍）的对比中贡献了 1.9 的 F1 分数；混合检索在流程内部贡献了 2.5 的 F1 分数，而类型化图扩展则无显著影响；对 12 种配置进行的轮次预算扫描显示，Locator 轮次少于四轮时增益趋于平缓，在四轮处出现一个台阶，超过四轮后则无进一步提升（§ 5.2 – § 5.5）。

paragraphs.en: Cost and open verification. Query latency is proportional to model calls and almost independent of corpus size (§ 5.8 ); the three indexed benchmarks are served as read-only knowledge bases (free account) with all prompts and runner code, so retrieval can be re-measured with no model and answers re-run with any model (§ 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 成本与开放验证。 查询延迟与模型调用次数成正比，且几乎与语料库大小无关（§ 5.8）；三个已索引的基准测试以只读知识库（免费账户）的形式提供服务，其中包含所有提示词和运行器代码，因此可以在没有模型的情况下重新测量检索过程，并使用任何模型重新运行答案（§ 8）。

(2026) ; Gutiérrez et al. (2025) find that graph structure does not beat strong embedding RAG on factual QA; our index ablation agrees (§ 5.5 ).

paragraphs.en: Input files are converted to Markdown (marker for PDF with OCR fallback for scanned pages; a text extractor for HTML; native for Markdown). The Markdown is split into fragments typed as text, image, table, or example. Each image and table fragment receives a description from a vision-language model so that it participates in text retrieval; the original asset is kept for reading. From text fragments an LLM extracts atomic knowledge points (title, one-sentence summary, source fragment). Relations between knowledge points are typed (same-topic, extends, contrasts, supports, prerequisite) by recalling similar points with embeddings and letting an LLM assign the type only to recalled pairs. For M3DocVQA this yields 332K nodes and 299K edges (133K typed) over roughly 200K fragments.

paragraphs.en: An earlier version kept one agent and asked it, in the prompt, to spend its first rounds locating and the rest reading. The Locator therefore does not have the choice: its tool set contains nothing that reads.

paragraphs.en: After the Locator stops, a fixed prompt asks the model whether the fragments found cover every entity the question chains through; if a hop is missing it names the missing entity and one follow-up query is issued for it. It exists because 78% of the documents missed by the earlier version of the pipeline were second-hop “bridge” documents.

paragraphs.en: The Locator could in principle ask itself the same question. In practice it stopped as soon as it had material about the first entity: the name of the second document only becomes known after reading the first, and the agent that has just declared “located” does not reopen the search. Making the check a fixed step after the Locator’s stop costs one short model call (about 300 output tokens) and removes the decision from the loop. On the full M3DocVQA the judge fires on 48% of questions and issues 1.1 follow-up queries on average; on MultiHop-RAG, where every non-null question needs two to four articles, it is the single largest source of the 14.5-point rise in “all evidence found”. A variant that let the judge also drop evidence it thought irrelevant lost 3.1 F1 on the 300-question subset and was abandoned: a judge that only adds cannot hurt recall; one that also removes can.
paragraphs.zh: 原则上，定位器也可以向自己提出同样的问题。 实际上，一旦它获得了关于第一个实体的信息，就会停止：第二个文档的名称只有在阅读完第一个文档之后才会被知晓，而刚刚宣布“已定位”的智能体不会重新开启搜索。 在定位器停止后增加一个固定的检查步骤，会消耗一次简短的模型调用（约 300 个输出标记），并将该决策从循环中移除。 在完整的 M3DocVQA 数据集上，裁判在 48% 的问题上会介入，平均提出 1.1 条后续查询；而在 MultiHop-RAG 中，每个非空问题都需要两到四篇文章，因此这是“所有证据已找到”这一指标上升 14.5 个百分点的最大单一原因。 一种允许裁判同时丢弃其认为无关的证据的变体，在包含 300 个问题的子集上损失了 3.1 的 F1 值，因此被放弃：仅添加证据的裁判不会损害召回率；而同时删除证据的裁判则可能造成影响。

Replaying the M4 queries offline, a 12K cap keeps the answer-bearing fragment visible in 89.4% of questions, 20K in 95.8%, 30K in 99.0%; we set 30K.

paragraphs.en: When the pool is full, blocks must be evicted, and text fragments score systematically higher than image, table and example fragments (a caption matches a question less literally than a paragraph), so a single ranked list evicts media first. In the M4 run the answer-bearing fragment sat at rank 1 in 58.5% of questions and within the top 8 in 91.7%; the remaining 8.3% sat at rank 9 or lower and were mostly figures, tables and examples (28% of answer-bearing fragments were tables, 12% images), exactly what table and figure questions need. The pool is therefore split into four sub-pools ranked separately (images 3K, tables 3K, examples 2K, text the remainder); within a sub-pool the top-3 hits of each search are protected and the lowest-scoring unprotected block is evicted first; expansion blocks and media attached to a text hit travel with it. In simulation the typed pool keeps the answer visible for 93.7% of questions against 86% for “top-5 per search”.
paragraphs.zh: 当池满时，必须移除一些块，且文本片段得分系统性地高于图像、表格和示例片段（一个图注与问题的字面匹配程度低于一个段落），因此单一排序列表会优先移除媒体内容。 在 M4 运行中，包含答案的片段在 58.5% 的问题中排在第 1 位，在 91.7% 的问题中位于前 8 位；其余 8.3% 的问题中，这些片段排在第 9 位或更低，且大多是图表、表格和示例（包含答案的片段中，28% 是表格，12% 是图像），这正是表格和图表问题所需的类型。 因此，该池被划分为四个子池并分别排序（图像 3K、表格 3K、示例 2K，其余为文本）；在每个子池内，每次搜索的前 3 个匹配结果受到保护，而得分最低且未受保护的块会被优先移除；与文本匹配结果关联的扩展块和媒体内容会随其一同保留。 在模拟中，针对“每次搜索取前 5 个”的方案，带类型标记的池能让答案在 93.7% 的问题中保持可见，而后者仅为 86%。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 places our results against the published systems; our claim is on the two multi-document benchmarks. On the full M3DocVQA the pipeline reaches EM 39.5 / F1 47.5 against 31.4 / 36.5 for M3DocRAG (44.6 / 53.5 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash); every later full-set system with a 7B reader reports EM ≤ \leq 27.5 Shin et al. (2026) , while our index with a 7B reader in one shot gives 31.7 / 38.0. On MultiHop-RAG, 73.5 is above the strongest published RAG and GraphRAG results (70.3 and 71.2). On the single-document MMLongBench-Doc the pipeline lifts the same 35B-A3B model by 12.2 points, from 34.8 in one shot to 47.0 (§ 5.7 ), which puts a 3B-active open model level with GPT-4o reading page images (46.3); the systems above it are RL-trained readers or frontier vision-language models, whose advantage is in reading charts natively rather than in retrieval, which a single 50-page document does not require.

paragraphs.en: M5 differs from M4 (Table 6 ) in the bridge judge and the pool: +1.9 F1 on the full set (206:155; CI [ 0.5 , 3.3 ] [0.5,3.3] , p = 0.003 p=0.003 ), +3.6 on documents found, with table +2.3, image +1.7 and multi-hop +2.2. paragraphs.en: Table 3 and Figure 3 show two different curves. Retrieval improves smoothly and saturates: documents found 71 → \rightarrow 77 → \rightarrow 81 → \rightarrow 82 → \rightarrow 84, then 84 at any larger cap. Answer quality is flat at 46.2–46.7 for caps 1+1 through 3+3, steps to 50.9 at 4+4 (three repeats, range 0.4; the 4.4-point gap to the 1–3 plateau is well outside the ± \pm 2 paired error), and stays at 49.2–50.6 for 5+5 and 6+6 while calls and latency keep growing (+25% time from 4+4 to 6+6). Single-role cuts locate the step: Locator 4 → \rightarrow 3 or 4 → \rightarrow 1 costs about 2 F1; Reader 4 → \rightarrow 1 costs 3.3, 4 → \rightarrow 3 nothing. With at most three hops, three effective searches plus one re-search is the smallest budget that covers the worst case. The model uses only part of any cap (mean Locator calls 3.5 at a cap of 4; the Reader is idle on 55–76% of questions).
paragraphs.zh: 表3和图3展示了两条不同的曲线。 检索性能平稳提升并最终趋于饱和：找到的文档数量从71 → \rightarrow 77 → \rightarrow 81 → \rightarrow 82 → \rightarrow 84，之后在任何更高的上限下都保持84不变。 在1+1到3+3的上限范围内，答案质量稳定在46.2–46.7；在4+4时提升至50.9（三次重复，波动范围0.4；与1–3平台期的4.4分差距远超± \pm 2的配对误差）；在5+5和6+6时则保持在49.2–50.6，而调用次数和延迟持续增加（从4+4到6+6，时间增加了25%）。 单角色削减定位了关键步骤：Locator从4 → \rightarrow 3或4 → \rightarrow 1会损失约2个F1；Reader从4 → \rightarrow 1损失3.3，而从4 → \rightarrow 3则无损失。 在最多三次跳转的情况下，三次有效搜索加一次重新搜索是覆盖最坏情况所需的最小预算。 模型仅使用了任何上限的一部分（在上限为4时，Locator的平均调用次数为3.5；Reader在55–76%的问题中处于空闲状态）。

paragraphs.en: Keeping M5 fixed and changing only the index: dense-only retrieval drops F1 to 45.0 ( − 2.5 -2.5 , 155:226; CI [ − 4.0 , − 1.1 ] [-4.0,-1.1] , p = 0.007 p=0.007 ) with first-search R@8 78.8 → \rightarrow 72.5; switching off typed graph expansion gives 47.0 ( − 0.5 -0.5 , 180:201; p = 0.56 p=0.56 ), first-search recall slightly up and answer visibility slightly down. Hybrid retrieval is a real component of the pipeline; graph expansion is neutral here, in line with recent evaluations of graph RAG on factual QA Han et al. (2025a) ; Xiang et al. (2026) , and we keep it only because it costs 45 ms per round.

paragraphs.en: On the same 300 questions, one-shot → \rightarrow M5 gains 7.8 F1 with Qwen3.6 (43.1 → \rightarrow 50.9) and 6.1–6.9 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash (47.2 → \rightarrow 54.1 / 53.3). The document-found rate is identical for both models in one shot (71.0) and rises to 82–84 for both in the pipeline: the retrieval layer is model-independent, and the pipeline’s gain is a shift of about the same size on both. On the full set Flash reaches 53.5 (Figure 2 ), 6.0 above Qwen3.6 at the same pipeline, so the design does not need a weak model to show its effect. An earlier version of the pipeline run in full with DeepSeek-V4-Pro reached F1 51.1 against 50.8 for Flash on the same version, so the two API models sit in one band and we kept the cheaper one. At the small end, Qwen2-VL-7B driven through the same multi-round protocol did worse than its own one-shot (mid300 37.4 vs 40.6) and Qwen3-VL-8B only tied it (41.5–42.3 vs 41.3): the pipeline found them 9 more points of documents, but they could not convert the extra evidence. The protocol assumes a model that can follow a tool-call format across rounds; below that threshold the gain is retrieval-only.

paragraphs.en: Table 4 runs the same four configurations on two corpora of different structure. On MMLongBench-Doc, S4 has no image tool and is a reference row; the fair comparison is across the three same-tool configurations. Going from 1+1 to 4+4 gains 5.5 points (CI [ 3.4 , 7.5 ] [3.4,7.5] , p < 10 − 5 p<10^{-5} ); removing the Deep Reader loses 9.8 (136:38; CI [ 7.6 , 12.2 ] [7.6,12.2] , p < 10 − 14 p<10^{-14} ) and P1 even falls below 1+1 (55:96): on a corpus of charts and tables, searching more without reading does not help. The 12.2-point gain brings the 3B-active model level with GPT-4o reading page images (46.3 accuracy / 44.9 F1 against our 47.0 / 41.4); frontier vision-language models that read the whole document natively score 57–62 (§ 5.1 ), an advantage in chart reading rather than retrieval, which a single 50-page document does not need. On MultiHop-RAG the ordering changes: P1 ties M5 (74.1 vs 73.5, 115:129; CI of the difference [ − 1.8 , 0.6 ] [-1.8,0.6] , p = 0.41 p=0.41 ), while M5 beats one-shot by 5.4 (243:106, p < 10 − 12 p<10^{-12} ) and 1+1 by 2.7 (174:104, p < 10 − 4 p<10^{-4} ). Every article is short and lands whole in the 30K pool, so there is nothing for a reader to open; the gain comes from the Locator’s extra rounds and the bridge judge, which raise the share of questions with all evidence found from 50.6% to 65% and lift the evidence-hungry comparison and temporal types by 9–10 points. The strongest published numbers are 70.3 (HippoRAG2, Llama-3.1-8B) and 71.2 (GraphRAG local search, Llama-3.1-70B) Han et al. (2025a) , the original GPT-4 baseline 56.0 Tang and Yang (2024) ; comparisons are indicative only, since retrieval units and contexts differ.

paragraphs.en: The answerable questions split 499 single-page and 360 cross-page. Every configuration is far better on single-page questions (M5 43% vs 25% judge accuracy, Appendix E ); on cross-page questions the best configuration reaches 25% and the one-shot baseline 11%, so the pipeline helps there too, but merging evidence that lives on two pages, typically a chart on one and its legend or a total on another, remains the main weakness. Refusals dominate the error mass: of the 859 answerable questions, one-shot refuses 475 and M5 274, and the 201-question difference is a larger part of M5’s gain than the questions it turns from wrong to right. Reading is the mechanism: M5 calls read_media on 0.50 questions on average and never on 636 of 1,082, against 0.27 and 788 for 1+1 and none for P1; the Chart bucket, where the answer is a value read off a plot, moves from 15 to 33. Earlier versions of the pipeline on the same questions scored 46.2, 44.3 and 45.4 with Qwen3.6 and 49.0 and 48.7 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, so the current version sits at the top of the band rather than being an outlier; GPT-4o reading page images sits at 46.3 accuracy / 44.9 F1, MM-Doc-R1 at 49.7 / 46.1 with an RL-trained Qwen3-8B Lin et al. (2026) , and frontier vision-language models at 57–62 on 2026 leaderboards.
paragraphs.zh: 可回答问题的分布为 499 个单页问题和 360 个跨页问题。在所有配置中，单页问题的表现都远优于跨页问题（M5 的法官准确率从 25% 提升至 43%，见附录 E）；在跨页问题上，最佳配置的准确率为 25%，单次提示基线为 11%，因此该流程在此类问题上也有所帮助。然而，合并分布在两页上的证据——通常是一页上的图表与另一页上的图例或总计数据——仍然是主要弱点。拒绝回答的问题构成了错误的主要来源：在 859 个可回答问题中，单次提示模型拒绝了 475 个，M5 拒绝了 274 个；这 201 个问题的差异，在 M5 的性能提升中所占比重，甚至超过了它将错误答案转化为正确答案的问题数量。阅读能力是关键机制：M5 平均对 0.50 个问题调用 read_media，在 1,082 个问题中有 636 个从未调用；而 1+1 配置的平均值为 0.27，有 788 个问题未调用，P1 则完全未调用。在“图表”类别中（答案需从图表中读取数值），该比例从 15% 提升至 33%。在同一套问题上，该流程的早期版本使用 Qwen3.6 时得分分别为 46.2、44.3 和 45.4，使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 时得分为 49.0 和 48.7；因此当前版本处于性能区间的高端，而非异常值。GPT-4o 在读取页面图像方面的准确率为 46.3%，F1 分数为 44.9%；MM-Doc-R1 搭配经过强化学习训练的 Qwen3-8B（Lin et al., 2026）时，准确率为 49.7%，F1 分数为 46.1%；而前沿视觉语言模型在 2026 年的排行榜上表现达到了 57–62%。

paragraphs.en: The four question types behave very differently. Inference questions are at 94–96% under every configuration even though they have the lowest all-evidence recall (R@all 73.0, Appendix E ): the answer is reachable without every evidence article. Null questions, which have no answer in the corpus, are at 97–98%: the conservative answer convention works. The gain is entirely in comparison and temporal questions, which need two or three articles and a judgement across them: 44 → \rightarrow 54 and 52 → \rightarrow 60 from one-shot to the pipeline. The mechanism is visible in retrieval: first-search R@8 actually falls from 73.9 to 61.0 when the Locator is allowed several rounds, because its first query becomes a targeted sub-question rather than the whole question, but the union over all searches rises from 76.7 to 84.2 and the share of questions with every evidence article found from 50.6 to 65.1. False refusals fall from 409 (18.1% of non-null questions) to 220 (9.8%); 149 questions that one-shot refused are answered correctly by the pipeline. The original GPT-4 RAG baseline is 56.0 (89.0 with gold evidence) and the strongest published numbers are 70.3 for HippoRAG2 with Llama-3.1-8B and 71.2 for GraphRAG local search with Llama-3.1-70B Han et al. (2025a) ; a third of the remaining gap to the gold ceiling is reasoning over the evidence rather than finding it. Two prompt variants that pushed the model to always conclude Yes or No when two articles agree reduced refusals further but lost 12.9 points on a 31-question smoke set by forcing conclusions on questions whose gold answer was a name; we kept the conservative prompt.

paragraphs.en: Appendix F traces one two-document question through all four configurations. “Which driver with a time/retired of +1 lap in the Trenton Twin Indy of 1979 has won the Indy 500 the most times?” (gold: Rick Mears). The race page’s prose names the winners; the “+1 lap” finishers exist only in the results table, stored as an image. One-shot answers from the prose (“Al Unser”, wrong, 2 s). The iterative-retrieval baseline P1 searches the race page four times, and its bridge judge, reasoning from the prose, asks for the Indy 500 wins of the wrong three drivers; the follow-up search does retrieve the List of Indianapolis 500 winners , but with nobody reading the table the answer is again “Al Unser”. The full pipeline runs the same Locator and judge, then the Deep Reader opens the results table with read_media and reads the four +1-lap finishers (Dallenbach, Mears, Sneva, Ongais); with the winners list already in the pool the synthesizer answers “Rick Mears” (46 s under the 4-way harness). The single-agent P0 also solves this question, by reading the table right after its first search; the point of Table 2 is that on average it does so far less often.

paragraphs.en: The protocol asks the model to emit one JSON object per round, to stop with a placeholder rather than an answer, and to keep a thought to one or two sentences. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash follow it; Qwen2-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B do not reliably: on the 300-question subset 113 of 300 runs of the 7B ended in a forced stop of both agents, and their multi-round scores (37.4 and 41.5–42.3) did not beat their own one-shot (40.6 and 41.3) even though the pipeline found them 9 more points of documents. The extra evidence was there and could not be converted. Prompt choice is also model-dependent: the official M3DocRAG answer template was the best of three prompts for the 7B model and the worst for the 35B model ( − 3.3 -3.3 F1 on the subset, − 1.4 -1.4 on the full set inside the pipeline), and a “positive phrasing” rewrite that removed every prohibition from the prompts lost 4.6 on the subset. We therefore did not tune prompts per model, and report the protocol threshold as a limitation: below it, the gain of the design is retrieval-only.
paragraphs.zh: 该协议要求模型每轮输出一个 JSON 对象，以占位符而非答案结束，并将思考过程限制在一到两句话内。 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 和 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 遵循了这一协议；而 Qwen2-VL-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B 则未能稳定做到：在包含 300 道题的子集上，7B 模型 300 次运行中有 113 次以两个智能体均被强制停止告终，且它们的多轮得分（37.4 和 41.5–42.3）甚至未能超越各自的单轮得分（40.6 和 41.3），尽管流程中为它们找到了额外 9 分的文档内容。 这些额外证据确实存在，但无法被有效利用。 提示词的选择也取决于模型：对于 7B 模型，官方的 M3DocRAG 答案模板是三个提示词中表现最好的；而对于 35B 模型，它反而是最差的（在子集上 F1 分数下降 −3.3，在流程内的完整数据集上下降 −1.4）。此外，一个移除了所有禁止性表述的“正向措辞”改写版本，在子集上的得分下降了 4.6。 因此，我们没有针对每个模型单独调整提示词，并将协议设定的阈值视为一项局限性：低于该阈值时，这一设计带来的增益仅体现在检索环节。

paragraphs.en: The sweep in § 3 is often read as “more rounds help until four”. The usage data (Appendix C ) says something narrower: from a cap of 3 upward the Locator reaches its cap on only 44–57% of questions, the Reader makes no call on 55–76%, and the amount of reading depends only on the Reader’s own cap (0.24, 0.38, 0.48, 0.67–0.73, 0.85, 0.90 calls per question for caps 1–6), not on the Locator’s. Neither cap alone explains the step from 3+3 to 4+4 (+4.7 F1): with the other cap at 4, the Locator’s fourth round is worth 2.3 and the Reader’s 0.6, although the Reader’s fourth round raises reads by half (0.47 → \rightarrow 0.67–0.73) while its cap-hit rate moves only from 23% to 17–18%. Raising both caps further raised reads again and F1 not at all. The model appears to stop early when it can see that little budget remains, and to read more when it has room, up to a point. This is an observation about one model in a loop that displays the remaining budget, not a general law; the threshold will move with the model and the loop design.
paragraphs.zh: § 3 中的扫描通常被解读为“更多轮次一直有帮助，直到达到四轮”。 使用数据（附录 C）给出的结论更为具体：从上限为 3 开始向上调整时，定位器仅在 44%–57% 的问题上达到其上限；阅读器在 55%–76% 的问题上无法做出判断；而阅读量仅取决于阅读器自身的上限（上限为 1–6 时，每问题调用次数分别为 0.24、0.38、0.48、0.67–0.73、0.85、0.90），与定位器的上限无关。 仅凭任一上限都无法解释从 3+3 到 4+4（F1 增加 4.7）的跃变：当另一个上限设为 4 时，定位器的第四轮价值为 2.3，而阅读器的第四轮价值为 0.6；尽管阅读器的第四轮使阅读量增加了二分之一（从 0.47 → \rightarrow 0.67–0.73），但其上限触发率仅从 23% 变化到 17%–18%。 进一步同时提高两个上限，再次提升了阅读量，但 F1 完全没有提升。 该模型似乎在察觉到剩余预算很少时会提前停止，而在还有余地时则会继续阅读，直到达到某个临界点。 这一观察仅针对一个在循环中显示剩余预算的模型，并非普遍规律；其阈值会随模型和循环设计的变化而改变。

paragraphs.en: The knowledge-point graph (typed relations between atomic statements) was built for browsing and summarisation in the product, and we tested whether it also helps retrieval. Inside the pipeline, expanding the top hits along typed edges is neutral (+0.5 F1, p = 0.56 p=0.56 ): it slightly raises answer visibility on single-hop questions and slightly lowers first-search recall on the rest by displacing BM25 hits from a fixed-size list. Hybrid lexical-plus-dense retrieval, by contrast, is worth 2.5 F1 inside the pipeline while only 0.5 in one shot: multi-round search converts better ranking into found documents, because the Locator decides what to read from the first few hits. We report the neutral result rather than dropping the component, since its cost is 45 ms per round and its value may differ on corpora with denser cross-document relations than a sample of Wikipedia.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为该产品构建了知识要点图（原子陈述之间的类型化关系），用于浏览和摘要生成，并测试了它是否也有助于信息检索。 在流程内部，沿类型化边扩展顶部命中结果的影响是中性的（F1 提升 +0.5，p = 0.56 p=0.56）：它在单跳问题上略微提高了答案的可见性，但通过从固定大小列表中替换 BM25 命中结果，在其他问题上的首次搜索召回率略有下降。 相比之下，混合词汇-密集检索在流程内部带来了 2.5 的 F1 提升，而在单次检索中仅带来 0.5 的提升：多轮搜索能将更优的排序转化为实际找到的文档，因为定位器会决定从最初几个命中结果中读取哪些内容。 我们报告了这一中性结果，而非移除该组件，因为其每轮成本为 45 毫秒，且其价值可能在文档间关系比维基百科样本更密集的语料库中有所不同。

paragraphs.en: The pipeline’s gain is largest where the model is weakest at scheduling itself, and the jobs are simple enough that each could be served by a smaller or specialised model: a Locator needs query reformulation and stopping, a Reader needs tool discipline and vision, a judge needs one structured decision. paragraphs.en: The three benchmark indexes are served read-only by the product’s retrieval API to anyone with a free account (an API key plus the index identifiers). We release the identifiers, fetch scripts for the official question sets, the scoring scripts, all prompts, and a reference runner that takes one configuration file (model endpoint, API address, index identifier) and produces a scored run. A third party can recompute document recall from the search endpoint alone, run the reference agent with their own model, or score their own agent against the same indexes. The served indexes were rebuilt from the same converted documents and extracted knowledge points as our runs, with figure descriptions and typed relations regenerated by the same model family; on the 299-question MultiHop-RAG subset with the same Qwen3.6 endpoint, the released runner scores 73.9 against 71.9 for our in-process harness (16:10 flips), inside the run-to-run band. Our model endpoint is not exposed and we redistribute neither documents nor raw outputs; images are read by downloading the asset into the third party’s own model. Repository: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench .
paragraphs.zh: 产品的检索 API 以只读方式向任何拥有免费账户（一个 API 密钥加索引标识符）的用户提供这三个基准索引。 我们公开了这些标识符、官方问题集的获取脚本、评分脚本、所有提示，以及一个参考运行器：该运行器只需一个配置文件（模型端点、API 地址和索引标识符），即可生成一次带分数的运行结果。 第三方可以仅通过搜索端点重新计算文档召回率，使用自己的模型运行参考智能体，或将其自己的智能体与相同索引进行评分对比。 提供的这些索引是基于与我们运行相同的转换文档和提取的知识点重建的，其中图片描述和类型化关系也由同一模型家族重新生成；在包含 299 道题的 MultiHop-RAG 子集上，使用相同的 Qwen3.6 端点时，我们公开的运行器得分为 73.9，而我们的当前工具包得分为 71.9（结果翻转比例为 16:10），这一差异仍在各次运行结果的正常波动范围内。 我们的模型端点并未公开，我们也未重新分发文档或原始输出；图片则通过下载资源到第三方自己的模型中读取。 代码库：https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench 。

paragraphs.en: Splitting a document-QA agent by job, with disjoint tools and code-scheduled hand-offs, beats one-shot retrieval by 7 F1 on the full M3DocVQA and the published systems on both multi-document benchmarks, and makes each job’s value measurable: the reader matters where evidence is visual, the locator and forced second hop everywhere, extra rounds and the graph layer nowhere.
paragraphs.zh: 按任务拆分文档-问答智能体，采用互不重叠的工具和代码调度的交接方式，在完整的 M3DocVQA 数据集以及已发布的系统所参与的多文档基准测试中，其 F1 分数比一次性检索高出 7 个百分点。这种方法还使每项任务的价值变得可衡量：当证据以视觉形式呈现时，阅读器至关重要；在所有情况下，定位器和强制性的第二次跳转都不可或缺；而额外的轮次和图层则完全无关紧要。

paragraphs.en: The main line runs on one self-hosted model, but the pipeline is validated in full on two model families: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash (F1 47.5 and 53.5 on M3DocVQA; 47.0 and 49.0 on MMLongBench-Doc), with DeepSeek-V4-Pro run in full on the earlier pipeline version (51.1, in the same band as Flash). Smaller open models (Qwen2-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B) were run on the 300-question subset only, where the multi-round protocol did not beat their own one-shot; the claims therefore hold for models that can follow a multi-round tool protocol, and the round-cap plateau in particular was measured only on Qwen3.6. M3DocVQA is Wikipedia-derived and partially memorised by large models, which is why we anchor on one-shot rather than closed-book. MMLongBench-Doc is scored by a model judge (we use our own Qwen3.6 as judge, following the benchmark’s protocol) and judge choice moves scores by 2–3 points. Latency figures are for one hardware configuration and one serial client. We did not tune prompts per benchmark beyond one rule paragraph and the format checker, and we report a prompt variant that helped on a smoke test and hurt on the full set as a negative result in the appendix.
paragraphs.zh: 主流程运行于一个自托管模型，但整个流程在两个模型家族上进行了全面验证：Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 和 DeepSeek-V4-Flash（在 M3DocVQA 上的得分分别为 47.5 和 53.5；在 MMLongBench-Doc 上为 47.0 和 49.0），而 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 则在早期版本的流程中进行了完整运行（得分为 51.1，与 Flash 处于同一水平）。 较小的开源模型（Qwen2-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B）仅在包含 300 道题的子集上运行，其中多轮协议并未超越它们自身的单轮测试；因此，这些结论适用于能够遵循多轮工具协议的模型，而“轮次上限”平台效应尤其仅针对 Qwen3.6 进行了测量。 M3DocVQA 的数据源自维基百科，且部分被大型模型记忆，这就是为什么我们选择以单轮测试而非闭卷测试作为基准。 MMLongBench-Doc 的评分由一个模型裁判完成（我们按照该基准的协议使用我们自己的 Qwen3.6 作为裁判），而裁判对步骤选择的评分会带来 2–3 分的差异。 延迟数据基于一种硬件配置和一个串行客户端。 除了一个规则段落和格式检查器外，我们没有针对每个基准单独调整提示；我们在附录中报告了一个提示变体，该变体在初步测试中表现良好，但在完整数据集上表现不佳，以此作为负面结果。

paragraphs.en: The model answers each round with a JSON object {"thought": ..., "tool": ..., "args": ...} or stops with {"thought": ..., "final": "ok"} . The rules state that the thought is one or two sentences, that the agent must never write the answer text in the loop (it is generated by the synthesizer from the collected materials and any answer written here is discarded), and that the agent should stop as soon as the materials suffice. Every tool result is followed by a one-line reminder of the same stopping rule; we found in-context reminders far more effective than rules at the top of the system prompt for the models used.

paragraphs.zh: M3DocVQA（所有问题均可回答）：“这个问题的答案肯定存在于知识库中：当证据不完整时，请给出材料所支持的最可能答案；对于是/否问题，请直接回答‘是’或‘否’。” MultiHop-RAG：“该基准测试包含证据不足的问题：当材料确实无法回答时，应停止并给出‘信息不足’的结论，而非强行作答；当可以回答时，请给出最短的实体或值；是/否问题需以‘是’或‘否’作答；对于涉及顺序的问题（如最早或最晚），请比较每篇文章顶部的‘出版日期’。” MMLongBench-Doc 不使用额外段落。

paragraphs.en: Answer requirements: Respond in English. Base your answer on the documents in this knowledge base; analyze as usual. Every question in this benchmark IS answerable from the knowledge base --- never reply ‘Not answerable’, ‘not found’ or ‘no information’: if the evidence is partial, commit to the single most likely answer supported by what you found; for yes/no questions answer yes or no. paragraphs.en: Two alternatives were tested on the 35B model and rejected: the official M3DocRAG text_rag template in place of our synthesizer ( − 3.3 -3.3 F1 on mid300, − 1.4 -1.4 on the full set inside the multi-round pipeline), and a “positive phrasing” rewrite that removed every prohibition ( − 4.6 -4.6 on mid300). paragraphs.zh: 在 35B 模型上测试并拒绝了两种替代方案：用官方的 M3DocRAG text_rag 模板取代我们的合成器（mid300 数据集上 F1 值下降 3.3，完整数据集中 F1 值下降 1.4），以及一种移除所有禁止性表述的“正向措辞”改写版本（mid300 数据集上 F1 值下降 4.6）。 在 7B 模型上，官方模板是三种方案中表现最好的，因此提示词的选择因模型而异，我们没有在小模型上使用的提示词基础上，在大模型上重复使用相同的提示词。 两种 MultiHop-RAG 变体在有两篇文献意见一致时强制要求得出“是/否”结论，结果在包含 31 道题的测试集上 F1 值下降了 12.9，因此在完整运行前被弃用。

paragraphs.en: From the M5 run, 414 questions have their supporting document as the first search hit yet F1 < < 0.5. A random 100 were classified into seven classes by DeepSeek-V4-Flash from the question, gold, prediction and trace, then re-checked independently by a second LLM reviewer (Claude) with the same material. The two passes agreed on 88 questions. All 12 disagreements were of one kind: 11 image questions on which the system refused (“not answerable”, “not found”) were labelled C (image not read) by the first pass and F (refusal) by the second; we keep C, because the failure is that the figure was never opened, and reserve F for refusals whose answer was present in the retrieved text . One synonym case (“spear gun” for “harpoon”) was moved from C to E. Final counts: C misread or unopened image 31; E correct answer at a granularity the metric penalises 23; A wrong field in the right document 19; F refusal with the gold in the text materials 13; B wrong table row or column 9; D multi-hop assembly 5; G other 0. By modality: text questions are dominated by A and E, table questions by B and A, image questions by C.
